items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-73
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin provides updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extensions
items.summary: Sansec reported that Amasty released a massive security update for 25 Magento extensions, with one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-53787) in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without authentication, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-45247) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, enabling remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Security Update Released – APSB26-49
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. These include stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and path traversal (CVE-2026-34653) for arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec identified PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. This vulnerability could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-21284), improper access control (CVE-2026-21285), and stored XSS (CVE-2026-21310) issues. These could lead to full system takeover, data leaks, and admin hijacking.
